cohort: 76 women with pregnancies diagnosed with trisomy 21 (T21) on antenatal or post-mortem/postnatal karyotyping
finding: Trisomy 21 fetuses have high rates of placental insufficiency, FGR, and Doppler abnormalities, and postnatally, most require respiratory and feeding support.
mod_finding: The majority of women with a trisomy 21 fetus were delivered by Cesarean section.
birth_weight: Birthweight was measured as an outcome
